verdicts.reason: A leaves the whole left half empty, which makes the layout lopsided. Its headline orphans 'here', the SOLSTICE brand sits below the headline, and the pills are stacked in reverse order in the top-right corner. B crams the pills against the top-left circle with mismatched pill text sizes, also puts the brand under the headline, leaves a big dead gap in the middle, and centres a CTA that doesn't line up with the left-aligned text. A at least keeps headline, copy and CTA together in one column.

Both use the same broken structure. The pills sit on the decorative circle, SOLSTICE is pushed below the headline, a large empty band separates the copy from a centred CTA, and the CTA ignores the left text edge. A's pills are a consistent size and its margins are a little more even. B's pills use mismatched type sizes and its headline almost touches the right edge.

A is the banner scattered across a square at its original tiny scale. The CTA floats between the headline and the subcopy, which breaks the reading order. The pills and subcopy are near-illegible, and the canvas is mostly dead space. B is readable and grouped, but it still puts the brand under the headline, leaves a big empty middle with the CTA centred against left-aligned text, and lets the pills overlap the circle.

B drops the unchanged banner strip into the middle of the square, leaving huge empty bands above and below. The text stays tiny, the yellow circle runs behind the headline and pills, and the CTA sits on the pink circle. This is a shrink, not a rearrangement. A is readable but flawed: SOLSTICE sits under the headline, the pill sizes are inconsistent and crowd the circle, a big gap sits above the centred CTA, and the headline runs to the edge.
